scenarioName: Scenario S1: HTML5 Canvas Chart Collision
description: HTML5 Canvas chart collision where a floating tooltip occludes Revenue Series Legend while Playwright sees 0 child DOM nodes inside <canvas>.

naiveBaseline.reason: Playwright DOM inspection querySelectorAll("canvas *") returns 0 child nodes because chart is rendered directly to an HTML5 <canvas> pixel buffer. DOM locators report PASS because they are blind to canvas visual collisions.
